_about: Blocks and towers that OSM mapped after the era snapshot, judged by eye against the era aerial (era_merge.py): built_since = open ground, a car park or a building site then (left out); low = a different, lower building stood there then (kept at 6 m); every other reviewed id stood. Ikon Park, Whitten and WACA: Esri Aug/Feb 2013; Subiaco Jan 2017; Football Park Feb 2013.

waca.aerial: Google Earth historical imagery, 22 Sep 2000 (oldest clear cover; reference only, never committed), registered onto the 1 m square at 1.26 m/px. Blocks and towers (1,500 m2 or 4 storeys and over) inside the frame are checked; smaller buildings follow the colour test; the CBD beyond the frame is not reviewed and stands. The 2013 review is kept as waca_2013. Across the river beyond the frame: Crown Towers (2016), Crown Promenade (2004), the members' car park and Perth Stadium's gates (2017) are built since; the casino, hotel and Burswood Dome stood.

ikon_park.aerial: Google Earth historical imagery, 23 Mar 2000 (oldest clear cover; reference only, never committed), registered onto the 1 m square at 1.25 m/px. Blocks of 500 m2 and over inside the frame are checked; the CBD beyond the frame is not reviewed and stands. The 2013 review is kept as ikon_park_2013.

whitten.aerial: Google Earth historical imagery, 23 Mar 2000 (oldest clear cover; reference only, never committed): five frames (centre, north, south, east, west) registered onto the 1 m square at 1.25-1.26 m/px, 95% of the square. Blocks of 500 m2 and over are checked. The 2013 review is kept as whitten_2013.

moorabbin.aerial: Google Earth historical imagery, Apr 2005 frame (oldest full cover; reference only, never committed), registered onto the 1 m square at 1.25 m/px. Blocks of 500 m2 and over are checked; those beyond the frame's edge are not reviewed and stand. The school's three classroom ranges on the south-east (demolished since) are traced from the frame. Three sites under construction or vacant today had houses or a works yard then.

windy_hill.aerial: Google Earth historical imagery, Nov 2000 frame (oldest clear cover; reference only, never committed), registered onto the 1 m square at 1.25 m/px. Blocks of 500 m2 and over are checked; those beyond the frame's edge are not reviewed and stand. Moreland Road's institution (demolished since, parkland today) is traced from the frame: 27 buildings, storeys from their shadows. Moonee Valley Racecourse was a racecourse then, not a building site. Three sites vacant or under construction today had houses or the institution's grounds then.

extra.what: Moreland Road institution, west wing and north-west range
Moreland Road institution, range west of the first courtyard
Moreland Road institution, range south of the first courtyard
Moreland Road institution, middle range between the courtyards

north_hobart.aerial: Google Earth historical imagery, 14 Oct 2003 (oldest clear cover; reference only, never committed): two frames, the ground's and the CBD's, registered onto the 1 m square at 1.25 m/px. Blocks of 500 m2 and over are checked. Seven newer CBD blocks (UTAS apartments, Melville Street, MS1) stand at one storey, as the low buildings then did. Blocks on the north-west edge, beyond both frames, are not reviewed and stand. The block on what is a building site today (500 m north-west of the ground) is traced from the frame: three wings.

extra.what: demolished block west of Argyle St, north wing

_city_hob_2003.aerial: Google Earth historical imagery, 14 Oct 2003, over the Hobart CBD (reference only), registered onto a 1 m square. Overture towers of 30 m and up past the ground's near square; every one stood (shadows in the frame).

_city_per_2017.aerial: Esri World Imagery Wayback release 8249 (Jan 2017, the Subiaco era aerial) over the Perth CBD, 1 m square. Overture towers of 30 m and up past Subiaco's near square; built since = a lawn, car park or construction site then. The two South Perth towers are checked on the same release.

_city_mel_2000.aerial: Google Earth historical imagery, 23 Mar 2000 (frames over the Melbourne CBD, reference only), registered onto a 1 m square. Overture towers of 30 m and up past each ground's near square; built since = open ground, a car park, a site or a lower building then, judged by eye (shadow-hidden ones re-checked at double zoom). Towers past the CBD are judged on nine more Mar 2000 frames (Footscray to Moorabbin); three are beyond every frame and stand.

_city_per_2000.aerial: Google Earth historical imagery, 22 Sep 2000 (the WACA era frame date), seven frames over the Perth CBD and Burswood, reference only, registered onto a 1 m square. Overture towers of 30 m and up past the WACA near square; built since = open ground, a car park, a site or a lower building then. The two South Perth towers were still a car park and a site in 2017.
